lines.en: It is Monday morning. Ana is at a small coffee shop.

lines.en: She is tired. She needs a coffee.

lines.en: Good morning! What do you want?

lines.en: Hi! A big coffee, please. No sugar.
lines.pt: Oi! Um café grande, por favor. Sem açúcar.

lines.en: Okay. Anything else?

lines.en: No, thank you. How much is it?

lines.en: Five dollars.
lines.pt: Cinco dólares.

lines.en: Ana looks in her bag. She can't find her money.

lines.en: Oh no. I'm so sorry. I don't have my money.

lines.en: Don't worry. You can pay tomorrow.

lines.en: Really? Thank you so much!

lines.en: The next day, Ana comes back. She pays for two coffees.

lines.en: One for me, and one for you.

lines.en: That is very nice. Thanks!

lines.en: And now, every morning, they talk a little.

lines.en: But he can't find his phone.

lines.en: Where is my phone? It was here!

lines.en: He looks on the table. Nothing.

lines.en: He looks under the bed. Nothing.

lines.en: Mia! Do you know where my phone is?

lines.en: No, I don't. Did you look in the car?

lines.en: Yes, I did. It's not there.
lines.pt: Olhei. Não está lá.

lines.en: Wait a second. I can call it.

lines.en: Mia calls. They hear a sound in the kitchen.

lines.en: The phone is in the fridge, next to the milk!

lines.en: Are you kidding me? In the fridge?

lines.en: I don't know. I was very tired this morning.

lines.en: They laugh a lot. Then Leo calls his mom.

lines.en: Good morning. Please, sit down. Tell me about yourself.

lines.en: Good. Do you have any questions for me?

lines.en: Yes. When can I start?

lines.en: Leo laughs.

lines.pt: Ana convida uns amigos para jantar na sexta.

lines.en: The problem is: she doesn't know how to cook.
lines.pt: O problema é: ela não sabe cozinhar.

lines.en: Mia, can you help me? I want to make something special.
lines.pt: Mia, você pode me ajudar? Quero fazer algo especial.

lines.en: Of course. Let's go step by step.
lines.pt: Claro. Vamos passo a passo.

lines.en: They go to the market and buy rice, chicken and vegetables.
lines.pt: Elas vão ao mercado e compram arroz, frango e legumes.

lines.en: At home, Mia explains everything. Ana takes notes.
lines.pt: Em casa, Mia explica tudo. Ana anota.

lines.en: Wait, how much salt? I don't want to make it awful.
lines.pt: Espera, quanto sal? Não quero que fique horrível.

lines.en: Just a little. You can add more later.
lines.pt: Só um pouco. Você pode pôr mais depois.

lines.en: On Friday, the friends arrive. The food is ready.
lines.pt: Na sexta, os amigos chegam. A comida está pronta.

lines.en: Wow, this is really good! Did you make it?
lines.pt: Nossa, isso está muito bom! Foi você que fez?

lines.en: Well, I had some help.
lines.pt: Bom, eu tive uma ajudinha.

lines.en: Everyone laughs. It was a wonderful night.
lines.pt: Todo mundo ri. Foi uma noite maravilhosa.

lines.en: Leo is moving to a new apartment. It is on the fifth floor.
lines.pt: Leo está se mudando para um apartamento novo. Fica no quinto andar.

lines.en: There is no lift, and he has a lot of boxes.
lines.pt: Não tem elevador, e ele tem muitas caixas.

lines.en: This box is so heavy. What's in it?
lines.pt: Esta caixa está tão pesada. O que tem nela?

lines.en: Your books! You have too many books.
lines.pt: Seus livros! Você tem livros demais.

lines.en: They carry box after box. After three hours, they finish.
lines.pt: Eles carregam caixa atrás de caixa. Depois de três horas, eles terminam.

lines.en: I'm so tired. My back is killing me.
lines.pt: Estou tão cansada. Minhas costas estão me matando.

lines.en: Thanks for your help. Let's order a pizza.
lines.pt: Obrigado pela ajuda. Vamos pedir uma pizza.

lines.en: They sit on the floor and look out the window.
lines.pt: Eles sentam no chão e olham pela janela.

lines.en: They can see the whole city from there.
lines.pt: Dá para ver a cidade inteira de lá.

lines.en: What a view! It was worth it.
lines.pt: Que vista! Valeu a pena.

lines.en: Yes. I think I'm going to be happy here.
lines.pt: Sim. Acho que vou ser feliz aqui.
